claims: In the 2025-26 NBA season, the Los Angeles Lakers won the season series against the Denver Nuggets.
Los Angeles Lakers defeated Denver Nuggets 115-107 on January 20, 2026 at Ball Arena.
Luka Dončić had 38 points, 13 rebounds, and 10 assists in the January 20, 2026 game.
Denver Nuggets defeated Los Angeles Lakers 120-113 on March 5, 2026 at Ball Arena.
Luka Dončić scored 27 points in the March 5, 2026 game.
Los Angeles Lakers defeated Denver Nuggets 127-125 in overtime on March 14, 2026 at Crypto.com Arena.
Luka Dončić and Austin Reaves led a clutch rally in the March 14, 2026 game.
Luka Dončić hit a game-winning fadeaway jumper in the March 14, 2026 game.
Los Angeles Lakers secured the season tiebreaker against Denver Nuggets with the March 14, 2026 victory.
The March 14, 2026 game carried significant Western Conference seeding implications.
Silver Screen and Roll says both teams were competing for a top-three spot
